categories.main_business_segments: Soosan Heavy Industries operates primarily in two segments: the Attachment segment, focusing on hydraulic breakers used for rock and concrete demolition, and the Special Equipment segment, which includes hydraulic drills and truck cranes for construction and logistics. The company also manufactures bulk trailers and other specialized vehicles through its subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes hydraulic technology for its breakers, drills, and cranes, emphasizing innovations such as auto-lubrication systems and piston protection mechanisms. Production methods involve in-house R&D centers dedicated to continuous product improvement and new product development, supported by ISO standards and internal work protocols to ensure quality and efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include construction companies, infrastructure developers, mining and quarry operations, and logistics firms. The company serves both domestic and international markets, targeting sectors involved in civil engineering, building construction, underground works, and heavy material handling.
categories.geographic_coverage: Soosan Heavy Industries operates mainly in South Korea with significant overseas presence through subsidiaries and sales offices in the USA, Vietnam, China, and Europe. Its export markets include Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Europe, Africa, Russia/CIS, and the Americas, with tailored strategies for emerging and developed markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing and assembling hydraulic construction equipment and special vehicles. It sources raw materials and components mainly from domestic suppliers but also from international vendors, integrating these into finished products for direct sale or through dealers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding overseas exports, enhancing product quality, and increasing production efficiency. R&D focuses on technological innovation in hydraulic breakers, drills, and cranes, including safety features, performance improvements, and product line diversification to meet regulatory and market demands.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of hydraulic breakers, drills, cranes, and specialized vehicles. Sales occur via direct sales, dealerships, overseas subsidiaries, and distributors, with payment terms including cash, telegraphic transfers, and letters of credit for exports.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Domestically, Soosan holds the number one market position in hydraulic breakers, truck cranes, and hydraulic drills, competing against firms like Youngwon STM and DY. Globally, it ranks sixth in hydraulic breakers, competing with industry leaders such as Atlas Copco, Sandvik, and Furukawa, emphasizing product quality and technological differentiation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately 226.5 billion KRW in the latest fiscal year, a 20.87% decrease from the prior year, with operating profit declining by 27.44%. Despite revenue contraction, net income increased by 7.13%, supported by improved cost management and financial income. Total assets stood at about 263 billion KRW with a strengthened equity base and reduced liabilities.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Soosan emphasizes superior product quality, technological innovation, and after-sales service to maintain a strong brand reputation domestically and internationally. Its hydraulic breakers feature advanced auto-lubrication and piston protection systems, while its cranes incorporate safety certifications and performance enhancements, positioning the company as a reliable and innovative supplier in niche construction equipment markets.
